description: This source file defines a static utility class 'ImageHelper' for managing image files within a document generation context. It provides methods to locate images within specified subfolders, check for image existence, and extract page numbers from image file paths with embedded page references.

classes.name: ImageHelper
classes.description: A static class providing methods for handling image file paths, existence checks, and extracting page numbers from paths with embedded page references.

methods.name: GetImageName
methods.description: Searches subfolders along the given image path to find and return the first existing image filename.

methods.name: InSubfolder
methods.description: Checks if a specific filename exists within the provided subfolder paths, considering multiple subfolders separated by semicolons.

methods.name: ExtractPageNumber
methods.description: Extracts a page number from a file path if it follows the 'filename#page' format and returns the sanitized filename without the page number suffix.
